tasks.description: One entry per child. Roles must be unique among your live children.

access.description: The child's access mode. Default inherit (yours); never broader than yours.

effort.description: Reasoning effort, such as low, medium, high or xhigh. Default inherit: yours on the same model, else the model's default.

machine.description: Run on this paired machine (a name from `machines`). Requires project.

project.description: The project on that machine, as `machines` lists it.

provider.description: Provider that runs the child. Default: yours, or the one serving `model`.

requestId.description: Any stable id; repeating a call with it runs once.

runRole.description: Run as a role from your Roles line.

task.description: The whole assignment: goal, files, constraints, project notes that apply, and how to verify. The child sees none of your conversation.

workspace.description: Where the child works. Default: this project's checkout. new_worktree starts a Git worktree from base; existing_worktree reuses one by path.

waitFor.description: With waitSeconds: return when all children settle (default) or when any does.

waitSeconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the children before returning, as `wait` does. Omit to return at once.
